name: audiobookshelf-mcp
description: Browse libraries, search books, and control playback in Audiobookshelf.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List all audiobook and podcast libraries

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search a library for audiobooks or podcasts by title, author, or narrator

tools.name: list_library_items
tools.description: List items in a library with pagination

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get detailed information about an audiobook or podcast by its item ID

tools.name: get_items_in_progress
tools.description: Get audiobooks and podcasts currently being listened to

tools.name: get_listening_stats
tools.description: Get your overall listening statistics including total time and daily breakdown

tools.name: get_listening_sessions
tools.description: Get your recent listening sessions with titles, dates, and durations

tools.name: get_media_progress
tools.description: Get your reading/listening progress for a specific audiobook or podcast episode

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: List all series in a library (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Get details of a series including its books (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Get details about an author including their books (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List collections in a library (opt-in via the browse toolset)

tools.name: get_chapters
tools.description: Get an audiobook's chapters, total duration and audio files. Times are in seconds. Files are listed for context only; they are rarely chapters. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: search_audible
tools.description: Search Audible for editions of an audiobook, closest runtime first. Pick the unabridged edition in the right language whose runtime matches the book. If none does, retry with another spelling of the author (Audible often uses initials) or another region. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: get_audible_chapters
tools.description: Get Audible's chapter list for an edition by ASIN and region. Times are in seconds. Compare with the book before saving: if runtimeSeconds differs from the book's duration, or the chapters sit a constant few seconds off the book's own (often brandIntroSeconds), shift every start by that offset before set_chapters. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: set_chapters
tools.description: Replace ALL chapters of an audiobook. Show the user the complete list and get their confirmation before calling. Returns the previous chapters; to undo, call again with them. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: rename_chapters
tools.description: Rename an audiobook's chapters, keeping every timestamp. Pass one title per existing chapter, in order. Show the user the new titles and get their confirmation before calling. (opt-in via the chapters toolset)

tools.name: get_metadata_overview
tools.description: Count every genre, tag and language used in a library, and how many books have no genres, tags, language or description. Matching is exact, so "English" and "english" are listed separately. Counts come from the books themselves, so they are current right after an edit. Use find_items to see the books behind a count. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: find_items
tools.description: List a library's books with their genres, tags, language and the first 200 characters of their plain-text description. Optional filters combine: genre, tag and language match exactly, as get_metadata_overview counts them; missing picks books that lack genres, tags, a language or a description. Sorted by title. Pass the itemIds to the write tools. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: search_book_metadata
tools.description: Look a book up in one metadata source and return candidates with their title, author, genres, tags and description (HTML). Use fantlab for Russian-language fiction, audible for English, and google as a fallback. Provider genres are hints to map onto the user's own genre list, not values to copy. If no source has a description and you write one yourself, tell the user. To find an edition's chapters by runtime, use search_audible instead. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: add_genres
tools.description: Add genres to one or more books (up to 100). Genres a book already has are skipped; a genre it has in another case is an error. Show the user the books and the genres and get their confirmation before calling. To rename a genre, call remove_genres with the old name, then add_genres with the new one. To undo, call remove_genres with the same genres on the books that changed. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: remove_genres
tools.description: Remove genres from one or more books (up to 100). Matching is exact; books without the genre are left unchanged. Show the user the books and the genres and get their confirmation before calling. To undo, call add_genres with the same genres on the books that changed. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: add_tags
tools.description: Add tags to one or more books (up to 100). Tags a book already has are skipped; a tag it has in another case is an error. Show the user the books and the tags and get their confirmation before calling. To rename a tag, call remove_tags with the old name, then add_tags with the new one. To undo, call remove_tags with the same tags on the books that changed. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: remove_tags
tools.description: Remove tags from one or more books (up to 100). Matching is exact; books without the tag are left unchanged. Show the user the books and the tags and get their confirmation before calling. To undo, call add_tags with the same tags on the books that changed. (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

tools.name: update_items
tools.description:
Set the language and/or description of one or more books (up to 100, at most 10 descriptions per call). Fields left out are not touched; an empty string clears a field. Descriptions may use simple HTML: p, br, b, i, em, strong, ul, ol, li, a. Show the user every change, per book from old to new, and get their confirmation before calling. For genres and tags use add_genres, remove_genres, add_tags and remove_tags. Returns each book's previous values; to undo, call again with them. Example items: [{"itemId":"li_1","language":"Russian"},{"itemId":"li_2","description":"

A blurb.

"}] (opt-in via the metadata toolset)

audiobookshelf_url.title: Audiobookshelf URL
audiobookshelf_url.description: Base URL of your Audiobookshelf instance (e.g. https://audiobooks.example.com)

audiobookshelf_token.title: API Token
audiobookshelf_token.description: API token from Audiobookshelf Settings → API Keys

audiobookshelf_toolsets.title: Toolsets
audiobookshelf_toolsets.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: libraries, items, playback, browse, chapters, metadata, or all
